import json, os, re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r'D:/repository')
SKIP = {'.git','node_modules','dist','build','.idea','.vscode','__pycache__','.nuxt','.next','coverage','.dsh'}
CODE_EXT = {'.vue','.js','.ts','.jsx','.tsx','.mjs','.cjs','.scss','.css','.py'}
MAXF = 300000

d = json.load(open(r'C:/Users/Administrator/.dsh/cache/memory-audit/select.json', encoding='utf-8'))

# discover project dirs
dirs = [p for p in ROOT.iterdir() if p.is_dir()]

def norm(s):
    return re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\u4e00-\u9fff]','',s.lower())

def find_proj(proj):
    if not proj: return None
    p = norm(proj)
    # exact-ish containment
    for d0 in dirs:
        dn = norm(d0.name)
        if dn and (dn in p or p in dn):
            return d0
    return None

# cache project text
cache = {}
def proj_text(p):
    key = str(p)
    if key in cache: return cache[key]
    buf = []
    for dp, dns, fns in os.walk(p):
        dns[:] = [x for x in dns if x not in SKIP and not x.startswith('.')]
        for fn in fns:
            if Path(fn).suffix.lower() not in CODE_EXT: continue
            fp = os.path.join(dp, fn)
            try:
                if os.path.getsize(fp) > MAXF: continue
                buf.append(open(fp, encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore').read())
            except Exception: pass
    t = '\n'.join(buf).lower()
    cache[key] = t
    return t

out = []
for i, c in enumerate(d['candidates']):
    content = c['content']
    title = content.split('\n')[0].strip()
    m = re.search(r'所属项目[：:]\s*([^\n；;，,]+)', content)
    proj = m.group(1).strip() if m else ''
    p = find_proj(proj)
    # key tokens: backtick identifiers + camel/file-ish
    toks = re.findall(r'`([^`\n]{3,60})`', content)
    cand = []
    for t in toks:
        t = t.strip()
        # keep code-like tokens
        if re.search(r'[A-Za-z_]', t) and not t.startswith('http'):
            for part in re.findall(r'[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*', t):
                if len(part) >= 4 and part.lower() not in cand:
                    cand.append(part.lower())
    if p:
        txt = proj_text(p)
        hit = [t for t in cand if t in txt]
        miss = [t for t in cand if t not in txt]
    else:
        hit, miss = [], cand
    out.append({'n':i+1,'sha':c['body_sha256_16'],'title':title[:44],'proj':proj[:22],
                'projdir': p.name if p else 'NONE', 'tot':len(cand),'hit':len(hit),
                'miss_tok': miss[:8]})
    o = out[-1]
    print('#%02d %-22s proj=%-20s dir=%-16s tok=%2d hit=%2d miss=%s' % (
        o['n'], o['title'][:22], o['proj'][:20], o['projdir'][:16], o['tot'], o['hit'], ','.join(o['miss_tok'][:5])))
json.dump(out, open(r'C:/Users/Administrator/.dsh/cache/memory-audit/verify2.json','w',encoding='utf-8'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
